caption:
The love between spouses is one of Allah's signs

Allah tells us that He created spouses for us from among ourselves so that we find comfort in them, and that He placed love and mercy between us. The verse ends by calling those who reflect to see the signs in this.

Surah Ar-Rum 30:21

Send this to your spouse, or to someone still praying for one

#marriageinislam #muslimcouple #loveandmercy #quran

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: And among His signs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves that you may find comfort in them, and He placed between you love and mercy. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect (Surah Ar-Room 30:21)
